svg.title: The L−1 gain requires centering before the norm. Site-independent orientation-wise output sums of U preserve neutrality. Summing K′(y, (z, b)) in z then gives a linear combination of the zero orientation-wise sums of K, so it vanishes. Shifting fine summation variables by L times a coarse shift proves covariance. Splitting absolutely convergent sums into residue classes proves exact torus periodization T ∗ torusKtorusUtorus. Applying the mixed stationary identity identifies this periodized packet with the coarse quadratic difference. These operations lift with the original orientations and absolute majorants. The predictor spatial estimates and constant-curvature transport property remain the stated dependencies; the secured pilot and wire bounds supply the former.
